`test_deployments.py warm-pool-cache` runs `minds-admin pool warm-cache` under the `ci-infra` activation (creating the env root when absent) instead of handing the gen-1 pool key to the subprocess, so the CI warm job can dial a gen-2 CI box with an operator certificate; a new `test_deployments.py sweep-ci-slices` command runs `minds-admin server sweep-ci-slices` against the CI infra DB the same way for the release teardown's crash backstop.
